title: OpenAPI generation, typed API client, and contract-drift check

gates.G1_requirements: EF-106 is the explicit next task in docs/TASKS.md after EF-101 through EF-105 were verified PASS.

G2_plan_approval.scope: Training Demo Platform Foundation; EF-106 is defined in docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md lines 466-471.

G3_execution_authorization.authorization: Execute this one bounded EF-106 packet only; no commit, push, deployment, or later task.

objective: Create a reproducible, server-owned OpenAPI document from the completed NestJS health API, generate a typed workspace client from it, and make drift a failing local quality check without adding business workflows or exposing services.

target_symbols.reason: registers the canonical OpenAPI configuration without changing runtime health behavior
documents the existing completed health endpoints and response contracts
one reusable document factory for generation and contract tests
reproducibly writes the tracked API contract and typed client
fails when generated outputs differ from source API contract
typed browser-safe client package generated from the OpenAPI document

forbidden: No controller, route, or business-domain endpoint beyond documenting the existing health endpoints.
No database schema/migration/data mutation, integration-stack start, auth, authorization, Redis/BullMQ, external provider, deployment, public listener, commit, or push.
No browser import of apps/api internals and no raw fetch from apps/web.
No generated client with any secret, base URL, cookie, environment access, server-only import, or network side effect at import time.
No arbitrary OpenAPI UI exposure or Swagger UI dependency; generation is build-time/local only.
No unrelated lint/format/config broadening or source refactor.

technical_contract.openapi: OpenAPI 3.x document generated from NestJS decorators/factory, with title/version and exact GET health paths.
technical_contract.generation: One deterministic script writes both packages/api-client/openapi.json and packages/api-client/src/generated.ts. Outputs must be stable across two immediate runs.
technical_contract.client: Exports typed HealthStatus and a createEstateFlowClient({ baseUrl, fetch? }) factory. It accepts an injected Fetch-like function; import has no network effect. Methods call only /health/live and /health/ready and reject non-OK HTTP responses without exposing body text.
technical_contract.drift: A check regenerates to an isolated temporary location and byte-compares both tracked artifacts; mismatch exits non-zero without mutating tracked outputs.
technical_contract.dependencies: Package additions are permitted only when required for actual NestJS OpenAPI document generation or TypeScript client generation. Pin explicit compatible versions in package.json and lockfile; no broad version ranges.

tdd: Write focused API document/client behavior tests first and run them RED for the expected missing contract behavior.
Implement the smallest scoped generation/document/client code until GREEN.
Record the RED command/result and GREEN evidence in the worker report.
acceptance: The generated document describes only the current health endpoints, uses a valid OpenAPI 3.x shape, and contains deterministic documented success/service-unavailable responses as applicable.
packages/api-client is a valid workspace package; its generated typed client compiles and can be tested with injected fake fetch without importing API internals or making a network call on import.
Generation executed twice yields byte-identical openapi.json and generated.ts.
Contract-drift check passes when artifacts are current and demonstrably fails against an isolated modified copy without changing tracked files.
Existing health behavior/tests remain green and root canonical checks pass except integration checks are explicitly excluded because this task must not start named test infrastructure.
No paths outside allowed paths change; record checksum audit against pre-execution manifest.
Update Task map and Current Handoff only after all EF-106 acceptance checks pass; otherwise document a truthful blocker/partial state.
